definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to a noun to mean the charge or payment for that service or thing. Especially common for transport fares, rent, and labor wages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|や}{賃|ちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧{賃|ちん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{手間|てま}{賃|ちん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The labor charge varies depending on the type of work.

notes:
Suffix forming nouns for fares, rent, and wage-like charges. Tends to attach to native or fixed Sino-Japanese bases (⟦{家|や}{賃|ちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧ rent, ⟦{運|うん}{賃|ちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧ fare). Less productive than 〜⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ or 〜⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{家|や}{賃|ちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧: rent
- ⟦{運|うん}{賃|ちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧: fare; freight charge
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧{賃|ちん}: train fare
- {手間|てま}{賃|ちん}: labor charge; piece-work pay
- {船|せん}{賃|ちん}: ship fare; passage
- ⟦{駄|だ}{賃|ちん}→駄賃：20360_dachin⟧: pocket money; small reward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧: bill; fee — broader; everyday utility bills and item charges
- 〜⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧: fee — formal institutional fees (⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}{料|りょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧ tuition)
- 〜⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: expenses — a category of spending (⟦{生活|せいかつ}{費|ひ}→生活費：19424_seikatsuhi⟧ living expenses)
